description: This file defines a Java interface named HeaderMapping which specifies the structure and behavior related to header mappings within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes method signatures for retrieving header mapping data and converting the object to JSON representation.

classes.name: HeaderMapping
classes.description: An interface defining header mapping behavior, representing mappings as a map with specific JSON serialization methods.

methods.name: getMapping
methods.description: Returns the header mapping as a Map from target to source as a String.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the HeaderMapping instance to a JsonObject considering a specific schema version and field selector, with a default method that uses notHidden field type.

methods.name: toJson (default method)
methods.description: Converts the HeaderMapping to JSON with default schema version and field selector.
